newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mixed, gas oil firmer.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mixed, gas oil firmer.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Thursday, with gas oil firmer and fuel oil easier, traders said.
High and low sulphur fuel oil were easier under the influence of crude and good supply.
Gasoline prices were steady but fragile after the arbitrage to the U.S. shut and crude extended its sharp selloff this week.
Naphtha was also steady but wet trade was thin due to volatility in the futures and a gradual shift to Feb material
Gas oil gained $5.25 on stronger futures. Heating oil premiums were stable. Low sulphur diesel was talked $2 firmer.
